exclusion_reason: A repeated recompiled run measures run-to-run jitter and confirms memory returns to baseline, but a real 30-minute sustained game run over the declared host set needs a game runtime that does not exist, so the sustained-stability bound is not certified.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when a sustained run over the declared host set holds its jitter, pause, and memory-return bound with a real game workload.
expected_failing_assertion: No game runtime executes a sustained run, so jitter, pause, and memory-return over a real 30-minute session cannot be measured.
active_gate_evidence: test/performance.test.mjs (benchmarkStability) repeats the frozen workload many times, asserts a positive median and a non-negative jitter (p99 minus median), that memory returns to baseline across runs, and that the sustained-game bound stays red (is_bar_cleared false).
procedure: Run the declared sustained duration on each declared host.
Measure tail-minus-median jitter and the largest pause.
pass_criterion: Jitter and pause hold their bound.
